name: Raiden restores Jax, Scorpion, and Sub-Zero
description: With Quan Chi no longer disrupting the counterspell, Raiden completes the reversal, saves Johnny Cage from the attempted revenant conversion, and restores Jax Briggs, Hanzo Hasashi/Scorpion, and Kuai Liang/Sub-Zero to living human form and free will. This occurrence does not imply that every revenant was restored at the same time.
